candidates.name: intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
support_spans: Liver MRI demonstrated an occupying lesion in the right lobe with mild intrahepatic bile duct dilatation, raising the possibility of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
Ultrasonography revealed a heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa in the right liver lobe
Contrast-enhanced CT showed a lesion in the right hepatic lobe adjacent to the gallbladder fossa
candidates.why: The combination of imaging findings, including a heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa, a lesion in the right hepatic lobe, and mild intrahepatic bile duct dilatation, along with elevated tumor markers such as CA19-9, supports the diagnosis of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
